Which of the following describes the fallacy of evading the issue?
Option A: arguing that someone should do something only because of ill will towards someone else
Option B: characterizing an opponent's position in a way that makes it seem ridiculous
Option C: supporting a claim with evidence or reasoning that is not relevant to the proposition, or responding to another's argument by changing the subject
Option D: attempting to gain agreement based only on the feelings aroused in the message
